paper_title: Constraints on axion-like polarization oscillations in the cosmic microwave background with POLARBEAR
notes: POLARBEAR search for time-dependent CMB birefringence from ultralight axion DM. No signal detected; median 95% CL frequentist upper limit g_phigamma < 2.4e-11 GeV^-1 x (m_phi/1e-21 eV), valid over 9.6e-22 eV <= m_phi <= 2.2e-20 eV. Data points generated from this analytic mass-linear formula (Eq. 28), evaluated at masses spanning the stated validity range. Assumes axion is all of the DM with local density rho_0 = 0.3 GeV/cm^3 and Rayleigh-distributed stochastic field amplitude (this weakens limit by factor 2.2 vs deterministic case, which would be 1.1e-11 GeV^-1 x (m/1e-21 eV)).
